summary_en: Update to July 2025 capital cost and stock price management disclosure. Current analysis and evaluation completed; improvement initiatives progress reported. New medium-term plan from FY2027 to be announced to further develop growth strategy and capital efficiency.
title_en: Update on Realising Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, Meisei Industrial disclosed an update to its July 2025 capital cost and stock price management initiative. The board has completed a current analysis and evaluation of the prior disclosure and reported progress on improvement initiatives. The company plans to announce a new medium-term plan beginning in FY2027 to further advance its growth strategy and capital efficiency enhancement efforts. Detailed information is provided in the attached materials.
